key_insight: The paper investigates joint formation and failure loads in friction stir welding of 2024-T4 aluminum alloy to SGF-PEEK polymer using a four-stepped outward-tapered tool.
engineering_relevance: This dissimilar-material joining approach is relevant to lightweight metal–polymer structures where joint integrity and load capacity matter.
method: Join 2024-T4 aluminum alloy and SGF-PEEK by friction stir welding.
Examine joint formation and failure loads.
evidence_signal: The supplied abstract provides only indexing information, with no experimental conditions, failure-load values, or comparative results.
watch_item: Tool performance and application readiness cannot be assessed without welding parameters, joint geometry, and mechanical test results.
paper_title: Formations and failure loads of dissimilar 2024-T4 aluminum alloy and SGF-PEEK polymer friction stir welding joints with the four-stepped outward-tapered tool
